title: peer_attachment_fetch: cache-hit test does not prove second download skipped the network
description: peer_attachment_fetch.rs step 5: downloads the blob a second time and checks bytes match. But the sender's TCP listener is still running, so if the cache lookup had a bug and always re-fetched from the peer, the test would still pass (bytes match from re-fetch). Add an independent oracle: shut down sender_handle before the second download and verify it still succeeds — this proves the blob is served from local cache, not re-fetched.
